text: {"name":"bt_process_connection_rx_frame","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Parses a received frame and updates or clears cached receive state for the current Bluetooth connection slot.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"connection_slot_table","v2":"connection_slot","v4":"rx_packet_flags","v6":"connection_context","v7":"rx_context_value","v11":"rx_descriptor_words","v12":"radio_status","v14":"rx_descriptor_flags","v22":"parsed_frame_out"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":36,"meaning":"Input frame flags; bit 0x200000 selects the parsed-frame path."},{"offset":68,"meaning":"Pointer to the connection context."},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Pointer to receive descriptor words."},{"offset":82,"meaning":"Input frame status flags; bit 2 selects an alternate path."},{"offset":44,"meaning":"Pointer to an object whose status is read at offset 60."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Connection-context flags; bit 0x400 is tested."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Alternate connection-context metadata value."},{"offset":88,"meaning":"Cached connection-context metadata value."}]}
